newsitem.title: USA: Chronimed Q3 net falls as revenues climb.
newsitem.headline: Chronimed Q3 net falls as revenues climb.

text.p: Chronimed Inc said Tuesday its earnings in the third quarter ended March 28 declined from year-ago levels in spite of a 20-percent increase in revenues in the period.

The company said net income slipped to 1.2 million, or $0.10 a share, from $1.5 million, or $0.11, in the third quarter last fiscal year. Sales in the most recent period climbed to $27.1 million from $22.6 million, Chronimed said.
Chronimed said it is encouraged by recent increases in self injectables patient referrals, new diabetes product introductions and growth in its StatScript subsidiary.
The company makes specialized pharmaceuticals and medical products for the care of patients with chronic illnesses.
Its shares closed off 1/8 Tuesday at 8.
